messages:
sumi: onboarding nova-lite-7B (llama->mistral fork) to int4. seeing embedding drift in long dialogs after ~1500 tokens.

leo: paste the exact cmd + seed so infra can repro?

sumi: `python run_eval.py --model nova-lite-7b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2000 --seed 7 --task dialog`. behavior: responses start repeating or becoming generic after token ~1520.

tereza: fp16 baseline ok? any convert warnings?

sumi: fp16 clean. token-diff reports 12 mismatches (mostly ZWJ/zero-width joiner cases). convert.log: `WARN: headmap permutation mismatch detected during shard merge`.

leo: try runtime test: `--kv-head-swap 2:5` or `--emulate-proj-order true` to see if headmap is culprit.

sumi: head-swap reduces drift but coherence drops. short-term mitigation: runtime fallback `--quant-fallback-threshold 1200` to int8 for long dialogs. opened PRs: convert#88, tokenizer-normalizer#89.

ops-bot: eval #9009 completed: metrics -> fp16 PPL=18.2; int4(raw)=23.7; int4+swap=21.5; int4+tokfix=19.3; int4+fallback=19.4.

tereza: tokenizer fix looks promising (close to fp16). plan: land tokenizer normalizer + conversion fix; keep fallback feature-flag enabled in staging; run 48h smoke; add sliding-window PPL check to onboarding harness.

leo: add regression test `tests/onboard/nova_long_dialog_repro.txt` and CI headmap roundtrip verification.

sumi: repro curl for ops: `curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_nova_dialog.json`. will monitor canary dashboards and ping eng-sre if error-rate > 2x baseline.
file_note: operational thread: model onboarding, quant regression, tokenizer & headmap fixes, fallback plan
